title: Logsign Unified SecOps Platform Incorrect Authorization Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of Logsign Unified SecOps Platform. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the HTTP API service, which listens on TCP port 443 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the user's license expiration date. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system.
